no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Heron Therapeutics is a commercial-stage biotechnology company with four FDA-approved products (ZYNRELEF, APONVIE, CINVANTI, SUSTOL). The 10-K Overview/Acute Care/Oncology Care portfolio sections describe only marketed products; no active P1/P2/P3 product candidates are described. HTX-034 (next-gen long-duration local anesthetic) appears in the IP/patent section only and has no active publicly registered trial since the 2020-2021 Phase 1b/2 program. All 20 historical sponsor trials in ctgov are Completed/Withdrawn/Terminated. R&D headcount is 7 (per 10-K human-capital section), consistent with minimal active clinical-stage pipeline.
